name: פתיחת סוגריים – מכפלת שלושה גורמים לינאריים לפולינום ממעלה 3 (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Write in the form

\[ a{{CT:0}}^3 + b{{CT:0}}^2 + c{{CT:0}} + d. \]

\({{CT:1}}=\) [[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Multiply two of the brackets first, then multiply the result by the third bracket and collect like terms.
Step 1 — Multiply two brackets
First multiply \(\left({{CT:2}}\right)\) by \(\left({{CT:3}}\right)\): every term of the first bracket times every term of the second, then collect like terms:

\[ \left({{CT:2}}\right)\left({{CT:3}}\right)={{CT:4}}+\left({{CT:5}}\right)+\left({{CT:6}}\right)+\left({{CT:7}}\right)={{CT:8}} \]

Step 2 — Multiply by the third bracket
Now multiply out the two remaining brackets: each term of \(\left({{CT:9}}\right)\) times the quadratic:

\[ \left({{CT:9}}\right)\left({{CT:10}}\right)={{CT:0}}\left({{CT:10}}\right)+{{CT:11}}\left({{CT:10}}\right) \]

\[ =\left({{CT:12}}\right)+\left({{CT:13}}\right) \]

Step 3 — Collect like terms
Add the terms with the same power of \({{CT:0}}\):

\[ {{CT:1}}={{CT:14}} \]

on_false.feedback: Your answer is not equal to the product. Multiply two of the brackets first (every term by every term), then multiply the result by the third bracket, and collect like terms. Watch the signs.
Your answer is equal to the product, but it is not fully expanded: multiply out all the brackets and collect like terms.
